coins.description: Virtual coins balance for unlocking premium features

unlockedFeatures.description: List of feature IDs unlocked with coins

guestTrialUsed.description: Whether the one-time trial was already redeemed

qrsCreated.description: Total number of QR codes created by user

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of user profile update

QRCode.title: QRCode
QRCode.description: Saved branded QR Code with design configuration and payload metadata

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved QR code

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

name.description: Name or title given to the QR code

contentType.description: Type of content encoded: url, wifi, vcard, file, etc.

summaryText.description: Short human-readable summary of the encoded target

previewThumbnail.description: PNG Data URL or thumbnail representation

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when code was saved

config.description: Complete QRConfig object containing styling, frame, colors, and content details

PublicFile.title: PublicFile
PublicFile.description: Publicly accessible media file record configured in the database for QR code sharing and public viewing

UserFile.title: UserFile
UserFile.description: Uploaded media file or document saved directly in Firestore by an authenticated user

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the file owner

userEmail.description: Email address of the file creator

url.description: Download or data URL string stored in Firestore document

previewUrl.description: Image preview data URL or poster thumbnail

customSlug.description: Custom vanity slug or short link

createdAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when file was uploaded

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds of last update

DynamicLink.title: DynamicLink
DynamicLink.description: Custom vanity short link and dynamic QR redirect record

id.description: Short vanity slug or link id

targetUrl.description: Destination URL where users are redirected

QRAnalytics.title: QRAnalytics
QRAnalytics.description: Real-time scan analytics, scan counts, geographic locations, and devices for a QR code

lastScannedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent scan in milliseconds

locations.description: List of geographic locations with scan counts and coordinates

recentScans.description: Log of recent scan events including timestamps, location names, and devices

devices.description: Breakdown of device categories (mobile, desktop, tablet)

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile metadata and authentication identity

/users/{userId}/qrcodes/{qrId}.description: Stores individual saved QR code designs created by the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/files/{fileId}.description: Stores uploaded media files and documents owned by the user in Firestore

/qrcodes/{qrId}.description: Stores user saved QR code configurations queryable by user ID and visible directly in database root

/files/{fileId}.description: Stores user-uploaded files accessible via file ID and linked to QR codes directly in database root

/public_files/{fileId}.description: Stores publicly accessible media files shared via QR code links

/dynamic_links/{slug}.description: Stores custom vanity short links and dynamic QR code routing destinations

/qr_analytics/{qrId}.description: Stores real-time scan counter and geographic location data for each QR code
